metadata.description:
In this week’s Tribal Bulletin, we begin by paying tribute to Kaluram Dodhade, a renowned tribal activist and leader of the Adivasi Ekta Parishad, whose passing marks the loss of a key voice in the fight for tribal rights. His contributions to the Adivasi movement will be remembered and honored by many.
This edition also highlights a recent study from Banaras Hindu University (BHU), which sheds light on the growing mental health challenges in Odisha’s tribal regions. The findings emphasize the need for urgent attention and action to address these critical health issues.
In political news, Jharkhand's Chief Minister and JMM leader, Hemant Soren, has launched a fierce attack on the BJP as part of his election campaign, signalling an intense political battle in the state.
We also bring you updates from across the country, with significant news from Kerala, where tribal issues are gaining attention, Sikkim’s Gorkha protest, and Tripura’s royal family’s ongoing role in supporting the state's communities.
Stay tuned as we continue to cover the most pressing tribal matters across India in this week’s comprehensive roundup.
